semiconductor_relevance: Medium — BOTH Engineering Technology Co., Ltd. provides clean system integration solutions that are essential for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: BOTH Engineering Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in clean room construction and HVAC systems, crucial for maintaining the controlled environments needed in semiconductor fabrication. With over 20 years of experience, the company offers comprehensive engineering services and solutions tailored to high-tech industries, including microelectronics.

regional_presence.China: BOTH Engineering is headquartered in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, and serves various high-tech industries across the country.
